message.content:
Send an email to kimse991228@gmail.com — the Solid ANSYS simulation batch is now 100% COMPLETE.

Subject: 🎉 Solid sim (cvbml01) 100% COMPLETE — all 384/384 cases done

Body (plain, upbeat, concise):
- The dist Type1 solid structural simulation (PyMAPDL / ANSYS v251, PCG solver) is now COMPLETE for ALL 384 cases (0–383) of project 65_final_0723 on cvbml01.
- Output: solid_0723/case_{i}/ansys_results_dist_0723/FC_case_{i}_{peak,low}.vtk — fibrous-cap results (~12–37 MB each), 768 files.
- Integrity: all 384 have BOTH peak and low vtks, 0 empty, 0 missing. Clean.
- Getting to 100% required, over this session: the main batch (366), then progressive re-meshing of the previously-unmeshed / failed cases and re-running them (127, 240, 305, 65, 151, 287, 343, 381, 27, 250, 380, 10, 376, 114, then finally 63, 215, 231).
- The one truly stubborn case, 168, failed 5 times with an identical IndexError. Root cause turned out to be NOT the solver or mesh geometry, but a bug in pv.from_meshio() -> meshio cell_sets_to_data() choking on a malformed 'gmsh:bounding_entities' cell_set in the mesh. Fixed with a 1-line patch (clear gmsh_mesh.cell_sets before the pyvista conversion; physical tags survive via cell_data). 168 then solved cleanly. The patch is harmless to all other cases and handles any future mesh with the same issue.
- Config: PCG, nproc 30, sequential, clean single ANSYS instance, wipe keeps only the FC vtk.

Everything is ready for downstream analysis. No cases remain.

- 384 케이스 모두 peak + low vtk 양쪽 존재, empty 0, missing 0. Clean.

■ 100% 도달 경과 (이번 세션)
- 메인 배치 (366) 이후, 미메싱/실패 케이스를 순차 재메싱 후 재실행:
  127, 240, 305, 65, 151, 287, 343, 381, 27, 250, 380, 10, 376, 114, 그리고 마지막으로 63, 215, 231.

■ 최대 난제: case 168
- 동일한 IndexError 로 5회 실패.
- 원인은 solver 나 mesh geometry 가 아니라, pv.from_meshio() -> meshio cell_sets_to_data() 가 mesh 내 malformed 'gmsh:bounding_entities' cell_set 에서 막힌 버그였습니다.
- 1-line 패치로 해결: pyvista 변환 전 gmsh_mesh.cell_sets 를 clear (physical tags 는 cell_data 로 유지됨).
- 이후 168 은 clean 하게 solve. 패치는 다른 모든 케이스에 무해하며, 동일 이슈를 가진 향후 mesh 도 처리합니다.

■ 설정
- PCG, nproc 30, sequential, clean single ANSYS instance, wipe 는 FC vtk 만 유지.

downstream analysis 준비 완료. 남은 케이스 없음."
